how: Claude agent reading of the stored title + abstract, blind to the curated graph, with EXTRACT_INSTRUCTIONS and CLAIM_SCHEMA

claims.quote: Schwannomatosis is a rare tumor predisposition syndrome that causes multiple schwannomas.

Using current classification guidelines, 64/71 LoF LZTR1 variants reported in schwannomatosis patients in the literature were classified as pathogenic/likely pathogenic, and their frequency in probands 64/359 (17.8%) was significantly higher than the frequency of potential LoF variants identified in the general population (0.36%; p < 0.0001).
